title: Undercapitalization is penalized by the minute at annualized rates from 500% to 3000% on the shortfall
content:
A.3.2.2.7.2.1.1.1 defines the Encumbrance Ratio as Aggregate Required Risk Capital divided by Total Risk Capital, so 100% is exact coverage and anything above it is a shortfall. Breaches split at 103% (A.3.2.2.7.2.1.1.2.1–.2): Low Severity is 100% to under 103%, High Severity is above 103%.

The penalty schedules are denominated as annual percentage yields on the shortfall amount, escalating with elapsed time:

- **Low Severity**: 500% APY for the first 30 minutes, 1,000% for the next 30, 1,500% thereafter
- **High Severity**: 1,500% APY for the first 15 minutes, 2,000% for the next 15, 2,500% for the next 30, 3,000% thereafter

The design has three properties worth separating. It is **proportional to size** — the charge applies to the gap, not to the Agent's balance sheet, so a marginal breach costs marginally. It is **proportional to duration at minute granularity**, which is only meaningful because the Encumbrance Ratio is computed from live data feeds; an Agent that cures a breach in ten minutes pays roughly ten minutes of a 500% annual rate, a real but survivable amount. And it **escalates on both axes at once**, so a deepening breach is punished for depth and delay simultaneously.

The apparently absurd annualized figures are the point of the parameterization: expressing the fine as a rate rather than a fixed sum makes it automatically scale-invariant and continuous, and the extreme annualization is what makes very short breaches still costly enough to deter. A 3,000% APY is roughly 0.06% of the shortfall per hour.

A.3.2.2.7.2.1.1.3 handles the accounting subtlety that severity can change mid-breach: each severity period is measured separately, from the moment the ratio crosses into it until it leaves. There is no single breach clock — the Agent is billed piecewise along its own trajectory.

Collection is monthly (A.3.2.2.7.2.1.1.6): penalties are calculated by the Core Executor Agents as part of the Monthly Settlement Cycle, then transferred from the Prime Agent's SubProxy Account to Sky by Sky Governance.
description: Penalties escalate with both severity band (Encumbrance Ratio 100–103% vs above 103%) and elapsed time in 15- or 30-minute steps, charged as an APY on the gap between required and total risk capital.
